text:
Death on her knees wells forth
+her white blood that is not blood.
+It smells of collateral.
+But now I feel like laughing.
+
+Something is murmured over there. They fall silent.
+Someone whistles courage sidelong,
+and one could even count in pairs
+twenty-three ribs missing
+one another, on both sides; count
+in pairs as well the whole rank
+of escorting trapezius muscles.
+
+Meanwhile, the police snare drum
+(again I feel like laughing)
+gets its own back and clubs us,
+again and again,
+from membrane to membrane,
+rat
+a
+tat.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem XLI — Death on Her Knees Wells Forth
translation.editorial_note: Garantía is translated as collateral to keep its financial and custodial chill; the broken tas con tas becomes an English drumbeat while retaining the staggered typography.
